title: Syrian Lamb Tagine
description: A flavorful and aromatic stew originating from Syria, made with lamb, spring onions, and a blend of spices.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the lamb pieces and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the lamb from the pot and set aside.
Reduce the heat to medium and add the chopped spring onions to the pot.
Cook until the onions are softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlicky sauce, Syrian spice blend, salt, and black pepper to the pot.
Stir to combine and cook for 1 minute.
Add the browned lamb back to the pot, along with the water.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then cover the pot and transfer it to the oven.
Braise the lamb in the preheated oven for 2 1/2 hours, or until it is tender and falls apart easily.
Serve the lamb hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley if desired.
